chunks.title: Global Ethical Finance Initiative (GEFI) (GEFI) COP31 Role & Commitments
chunks.text: Global Ethical Finance Initiative (GEFI) is a Climate Finance Network / Public Facilitator headquartered in United Kingdom. At UNFCCC COP31 in Antalya (November 9-20, 2026), its verified role is: COP31 Business Forum Climate Finance & Investments Working Group member (Path to COP31 Ethical & Islamic Climate Finance). Verified COP31 2026 climate finance commitment: Mobilizing ethical & Shariah-aligned institutional investors toward SDG & Paris-aligned climate projects via Path to COP31 platform. Source verification: https://www.copbusiness.org/papers/COP31_WG_climate-finance-investments.pdf.

chunks.title: GEFI Financing Instruments & Ticket Bounds
chunks.text: Global Ethical Finance Initiative (GEFI) provides the following climate financing instruments: Ethical Investor Syndicate Intro, Green Sukuk Structuring Network, Impact Dealroom Access. Typical transaction ticket range is USD 500,000 to USD 100,000,000. Eligible applicant profiles include: Climate-Tech Startup, Project SPV, SME, Fund Manager, Large Corporate.

chunks.title: GEFI Priority Climate Sectors & Regional Mandate
chunks.text: Priority climate sectors funded by Global Ethical Finance Initiative (GEFI): Climate Adaptation & Resilience, Renewable Energy, Zero Waste & Circular Economy, Sustainable Agriculture & Water, Climate-Tech Innovation. Target geographic focus includes: Global, Türkiye, MENA, Europe, Asia, Africa. Projects outside primary regions or ticket bounds may require syndicated or on-lending structures.

chunks.title: GEFI Mandatory Form & Underwriting Requirements
chunks.text: Mandatory requirements to complete GEFI's application form: Strong UN SDG alignment & ethical/transparent governance; Verified measurable environmental & social impact; Clear investable pilot or blended-finance structure. Explicit exclusion rules: Non-ethical or fossil-fuel-intensive activities. Official application portal: https://www.globalethicalfinance.org/.

chunks.title: GEFI Form Template: Climate Private Equity / Catalytic Capital / Venture Investment Intake Form
chunks.text: Global Ethical Finance Initiative (GEFI) uses the 'Climate Private Equity / Catalytic Capital / Venture Investment Intake Form' workflow governed by GFANZ Catalytic Capital Repository / Impact Management Project (IMP) / IRIS+ Climate Metrics. Typical review timeline is 4–10 weeks (Pitch Screening -> Commercial & Climate DD -> IC Approval). Form sections required: 1. Venture / Asset Overview, 2. Investment Thesis, 3. Product & Execution, 4. Impact & Risk, 5. Executive Pitch.
